summary: E2E test of Samvaad Charades (Fastify API + React/Vite dist) via public URL. All requested fixes verified working: admin email switch (bhattastha.dibd@gmail.com is manager, game_admin@cag.gov.in is not), profile dropdown renders above body on How-to-Play/Rules (desktop + mobile, all 6 items on top via elementFromPoint), header sticky on Rules, no 'no_pages' on Trial/Primary (Primary loads 10-page bundle with BHASHINI draft), office autofill on registration (Guwahati + Delhi), inline glossary underlines on English source (80-91 terms) and Hindi editor text with menus showing Approved/Also accepted/Avoid options, toolbar Bold, submit -> report card 29/100 +0.9 credits, RBAC 403 for player on /api/admin/*, manager console (overview, content library 5 published bundles, Sahayak script editor). Dev code 123456 rejected. TWO blocking environment issues found: (1) OTP email cannot be sent to ANY @cag.gov.in address - Emergent email proxy returns 422 'undeliverable_recipient: domain cag.gov.in has rejected every email... placeholder or parked domain', API returns 500 server_error and UI shows 'Something went wrong. Try again.' - real CAG officers cannot sign in/register. (2) At test start the whole site was BLANK: dist was rebuilt (09:32) after Fastify started (09:31); @fastify/static is registered with wildcard:false so new hashed assets were not routed and the notFound handler served index.html for /assets/*.js (MIME text/html). I restarted `frontend` supervisor which fixed it.

critical.issue: Returns 500 {error:server_error} for every @cag.gov.in email. Root cause: Emergent email proxy (integrations.emergentagent.com/api/v1/email/send) responds 422 code=undeliverable_recipient: 'The domain cag.gov.in has rejected every email sent to it'. Primary player domain cannot receive OTP -> registration/sign-in impossible for real users (gmail works).

@fastify/static registered with wildcard:false in apps/api/src/app.ts: files built after server start are not served; notFound handler returns index.html (text/html) for missing JS/CSS -> blank white page. Happened in this env after `pnpm build` without API restart.

minor.issue: sendOtp failure is thrown as generic Error -> 500 server_error; also the otp_challenges row (new hash, sent_count++) is written before send fails. Should map to e.g. 502 {error:'otp_send_failed'} with a specific UI message and not consume rate-limit quota.

First result is 'DG/PD of Audit (Power), New Delhi at Bhopal (Branch Office)' whose address is Bhopal - users typing Delhi and taking first option get a Bhopal address. Consider ranking city/state match above name match.

integration_issues.issue: Create my player card -> 'Something went wrong. Try again.' under email field (backend 500, see critical). Generic message gives user no hint.

issues: Top nav 'My profile' wraps onto two lines on /report/:id
'LEVEL 1 · REVIEW BUILD' / 'LEVEL 2 · REVIEW BUILD' label visible to players (pages are sample=true)
Source glossary underlines very dense incl. common words (other, time, High, poor, rest, actual) - optional stop-list

action_items: CRITICAL: OTP email to @cag.gov.in is rejected by the Emergent email proxy (422 undeliverable_recipient). Configure a real SMTP_URL (NIC/CAG relay) or another provider for cag.gov.in recipients, or contact Emergent support; verify with a real cag.gov.in inbox.
Handle OTP send failures gracefully: return 502 otp_send_failed (not 500), show specific UI message, don't increment sent_count on failure.
Fix static serving: use @fastify/static wildcard:true (or always restart API after build) and return 404 (not index.html) for missing /assets/* files.
Update /app/memory/test_credentials.md - it still says manager is game_admin@cag.gov.in; should be bhattastha.dibd@gmail.com and mention test-otp.sh.
Optional: hide 'REVIEW BUILD' label from players; fix 'My profile' nav wrap on report page; improve office search ranking.

rca of the issue: Blank page: dist rebuilt at 09:32 after Fastify start 09:31; @fastify/static wildcard:false registers routes only for files present at boot; new index-HBI6wb1I.js hit setNotFoundHandler -> index.html -> MIME error.
